about: Hand-curated venue research for the Israel Neurological Association conference, keyed by the code its congress-site adapter gives the venue, with the halls the programme names. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

expo-tel-aviv.name: Expo Tel Aviv
expo-tel-aviv.notes: The site names the venue and its address but not the pavilion; plenaries and shared sessions fill Halls A3 and A4 together (the programme).
